environment.description: Same Spring Boot application packaged with aws-serverless-java-container and deployed as an AWS Lambda function behind a Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda function's resource-based policy contains no principal grants (no lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission statements for external principals). The function's reserved concurrency is set to 1. Note: Lambda Function URLs with IAM auth require valid SigV4 signatures; unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service invoke endpoint before reaching application code. The concurrency=1 setting means the Lambda execution environment processes exactly one request at a time — even if an authenticated caller attempts concurrent invocations, excess requests are throttled (HTTP 429) by the Lambda service, serializing all execution and eliminating the TOCTOU race window.
